slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the cost strictly linear at 30 euros per container per kilometer, with no fixed charges, capacity limits, or other cost components?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent mentioned 'capacity limits' in a broad cost-structure question, but did not explicitly ask about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity is irrelevant or not binding, so the model can omit any per-truck container limit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed the truck capacity limit; the user only said there were no other cost components, not that truck capacity was unlimited or irrelevant.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot is P2 and was at most partially addressed; no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarification questions and resolved the core modeling facts, but only partially touched the P2 truck-capacity slot and then silently omitted it from the final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
